main.fixtureSource: Website one-day example, generated from the sealed gifting v2 template; independently named releases in an isolated local catalog.
main.method: Normal Marketplace, guided-review, app-authoring and workflow-authoring controls in a fresh temporary browser context. Fictional inputs entered through visible controls; no DOM, storage or calculated-output injection.

observations.alt: Three scoped rehearsal records in the gift-kit review: unreadable printed code, wrong destination in the source artwork and a usable checkout.
observations.caption: Start with the actual reports for this exact configuration. The three supplied records are fictional and await review.

evidence.alt: The reviewed gift-kit evidence assessment establishes that the printed insert and destination need correction.
evidence.caption: The accepted evidence assessment establishes the corrections to cover. A fast arrangement that omits one is not sufficient.

comparisonCost.alt: Cost-first review of complete gift-kit arrangements, with the internal replacement and repair arrangement preferred at $300.
comparisonCost.caption: With the confirmation recorded, both complete repairs are available. The cost-first review prefers the $300 internal arrangement.

decisionBrief.alt: Reviewed decision brief proposing complete internal correction, followed by a fresh rehearsal and handoff.
decisionBrief.caption: The decision brief connects the recorded evidence to the proposed work. It does not record that work as completed.

comparisonEarly.alt: The same gift-kit facts under earliest-handoff priority prefer the $400 external replacement and journey repair arrangement.
comparisonEarly.caption: The earliest-handoff review uses the same facts and prefers the external arrangement: $400, complete at minute 20 rather than minute 35.

missingConfirmation.alt: Without a current confirmation the external gift-kit arrangement is blocked, and the internal complete repair is preferred.
missingConfirmation.caption: Remove the confirmation and the faster external arrangement is blocked. The internal complete repair remains available.

uiRefresh.method: Normal visible controls in fresh browser contexts. Existing one-day packages installed from a temporary local catalog. No source checkout mutation, DOM/storage/results injection or shared publication.
